text:
Maya Gupta: Starting KiteCare POC scoping thread. Need a short prioritized list of user journeys + concrete success criteria and any deal blockers (security/pricing/infra). Please keep replies to bullets so I can forward to customer.

Liam Ortega: My priority picks for POC (compact):
- Triage routing chat (detect intent + route to human/auto)
- Knowledge base answer + cite links (reduce handle time)
- Billing / claim clarification assistant (structured responses)

Nina Park: Endpoints to surface during POC:
- POST /v1/intent/route -> returns intent + recommended queue
- POST /v1/qa/retrieve -> embeddings-backed retrieval + source links
- POST /v1/assist/billing -> structured JSON reply with action suggestions

Samir Desai: Ops constraints/ops recommendations:
- Use a single LLM family (quant 8-bit 13B) to cover quality for billing dialogs
- Use prefix cache for common FAQ to cut cost
- Canary plan: 10% -> 50% -> 100% with 15min observation windows

Nina Park: Suggested success criteria (measurable):
- KB accuracy: >= 90% (human-labeled correctness)
- Intent classification: F1 >= 0.88
- Latency: chat p50 < 180ms, p95 < 650ms for europe region
- Business KPI: reduce avg handle time by 25% on triage flow
- Error/hallucination: < 3% on eval set

Maya Gupta: Nice. Customer asked about eval sizing and prompt examples — what do we need?

Liam Ortega: Eval plan:
- 400 triage messages (50/50 common/edge)
- 350 KB QA pairs (with source ground-truth)
- 150 billing scenarios with expected JSON outputs
- Metrics: classification F1, retrieval recall@5, exact match for structured outputs, human helpfulness 1-5 for final check

Nina Park: Quick prompt template for retrieval (to include in harness):
```
User: How do I update my payment method?
System: Retrieve top 3 relevant KB articles, include the article id and excerpt, and indicate confidence 0-1.
```

Samir Desai: Security / compliance flags:
- Data residency: customer requires EU processing for PII (eu-central-1).
- Logging: redact payment identifiers before storing; retention 14 days for POC logs.
- KMS: customer wants to bring their own CMK — confirm feasibility.
- SSO: Okta SAML required for console access.

LegalBot: Note: DPA + SOC2 required for production contract. For short POC we can provisionally accept hosted with contractual carveouts; legal needs confirmation of log retention and redaction method.

Maya Gupta: Pricing questions from customer:
- Can they run POC on hosted with capped spend?
- Rough hosted cost estimate for 10M tokens/month vs 50M tokens/month?
- Any minimum for enterprise features (SSO/KMS)?

Liam Ortega: Hosted POC supported with spend cap. Quick back-of-envelope:
- 10M tokens/mo ~ $650 (hosted) with quantized models and caching
- 50M tokens/mo ~ $2,800 (hosted)
If Dedicated required (VPC + CMK) add a fixed $6k/mo baseline for reserved infra for POC. I'll get formal numbers from finance.

Nina Park: Implementation notes / fallbacks:
- Fallback path: if LLM confidence < threshold, return retrieval-only answer and auto-create human ticket.
- Monitoring: track confidence, latency, error rate, and hallucination alerts tied to eval prompts.

OpsBot: New maintenance window available Friday. Ping @Samir Desai to confirm instance changes. :gear:

Samir Desai: I need expected QPS to size infra. Rough estimate: for pilot assume 30 QPS peak. For that p50 target we'll need 3 small GPUs with autoscale headroom.

Maya Gupta: Action items / owners / deadlines:
- Liam: deliver eval CSVs (triage 400, kb 350, billing 150) and example labels by 1902620000
- Nina: draft security checklist + confirm CMK path by 1902590000
- Samir: infra sizing + provisional cost for hosted vs dedicated by 1902670000
- Legal: confirm acceptable logfile redaction language by 1902600000

Liam Ortega: I'll upload evals to shared drive and add basic scoring scripts.

Nina Park: Will prepare a short bullets doc on redaction approach and sample retention policy.

Maya Gupta: Any immediate blockers to starting the pilot next week?

Samir Desai: No blockers once we have evals and CMK confirmation.

LegalBot: Blocker: need sign-off on short-term data handling terms from customer. If they sign the temporary addendum we can proceed on hosted.

Maya Gupta: Great. I'll compile this and send to KiteCare after Liam uploads evals and Legal confirms addendum. Thanks everyone. :pray:

OpsBot: Thread set to auto-archive in 14 days.
